messages:
sophia_cs: Quick sync: HarborLogic onboarding asks for SG peering + short pilot bump to 200 QPS for 10 days. Also want header allowlist for X-HL-Client / X-HL-Sign and IP CIDR peering. Renewal ~45d out; they want this in the pilot window. Can infra + network confirm?
luis_net: SG peering doable. need the CIDRs, ASN, peering key, and whether they want BGP auth.
sophia_cs: customer sent details:
```
{
  "cidrs": ["198.51.100.0/26", "203.0.113.64/27"],
  "asn": 64530,
  "peering_key": "hl-peer-03",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps": 200,
  "duration_days": 10,
  "allow_headers": ["X-HL-Client", "X-HL-Sign"],
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```
requested start: 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z (customer morning).
derek_sre: i'll add an edge policy to allow only those headers when the HL token is used and set a 10d TTL for auto-revoke. monitoring thresholds: alert if 5xx > 1% or p99 latency increase > 200ms. fallback routing -> small-model-v1.
luis_net: opening NET-6240 peering ticket, scheduling preliminary work 00:30 PDT before change window. will publish BGP session + BFD settings once live.
marta_success: noted and updated renewal pipeline. sent cost estimate to customer (prorated ~ $900). customer requested an invoice addendum.
ops-bot: Ticket NET-6240 created for HL-03: "SG peering + 200 QPS 10d bump + header allowlist". change window: 2026-04-05T09:00Z, expiry: 2026-04-15T09:00Z. config id cfg-9001.
derek_sre: pushed staging config cfg-9001; canary at 5% for 20m, then full. added alerts and auto-revoke job.
luis_net: BGP session up (ASN 64530), prefixes accepted, session stable.
derek_sre: first 60m in prod: p50 steady, p95 +40ms, 5xx <0.5%. all good so far.
sophia_cs: customer signed the pilot addendum and requested a 30-min enablement walkthrough tomorrow. i added enablement checklist items and will attach recording.
marta_success: renewal owner assigned; set a 30-day pre-expiry reminder to review usage and conversion.
sophia_cs: awesome — please paste any final runbook notes here and i'll mark onboarding complete after 24h of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
